Job Summary 
 The Pricing Analyst is responsible for analyzing market trends, customer behavior, competitor pricing, and internal cost data to recommend profitable pricing strategies. Pricing analysts commonly work with sales, finance, marketing, and operations teams and use data analysis, reporting, and financial modeling to support pricing decisions

 Analyze market, customer, and competitor pricing data to identify pricing opportunities. Develop, maintain, and improve pricing models and pricing analysis tools. Review pricing requests, pricing changes, and margin impacts to support business decisions. Prepare reports, dashboards, and presentations on pricing performance and trends. Work with sales, finance, marketing, and product teams to align pricing strategies. Monitor key performance indicators such as margin, revenue, volume, and win rate. Research industry trends, promotions, and competitor activity to inform recommendations. Support the implementation of new pricing strategies, rules, and processes. Maintain accurate pricing records and ensure consistency across systems. Provide recommendations that balance profitability, competitiveness, and customer needs.
